part.text:
Fixed. The grammar in src/parser.y:622 required an `else` clause to terminate an `elif` chain. I added the rule `"elif" Exp "then" Exp "end"` to `ElseBody` (treating the missing `else` as `gen_noop()`, same as a bare `if`), regenerated `src/parser.c`/`src/parser.h` with bison (no new conflicts), and rebuilt.

Verified:
- `1,2,3 | if . == 1 then 1 elif . == 2 then 2 end` → `1 2 3` (multiple `elif`s work too)
- Bare `if`/`if-else` still behave as before
- `make check`: all 7 test suites pass
